post.title: Average US family: $1M+ net worth. Typical one: $192,900
post.ig:
In 2022, the average US family's net worth topped $1 million.
The typical (median) family had $192,900; the mean was $1,063,700 (Fed Survey of Consumer Finances, 2022).
Net worth = what you own minus what you owe. Example: $20,000 owned - $25,000 owed = -$5,000.
Families under 35 had a median net worth of $39,000 in 2022.
Source: Federal Reserve, Survey of Consumer Finances 2022 (published Oct 2023). Figures in 2022 dollars.
News and education, not financial advice.
